mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) > 1200 and GDP growth (GDPC1) > 18000 billion dollars indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST>1200 AND GDPC1>18000) yields positive returns in <40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 100 (INDPRO) in early-cycle expansion signals rising manufacturing output, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 fails to yield positive returns in >50% of early-cycle expansion instances (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 250 reflects persistent inflation, increasing real interest rate expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1200 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1200 fails to predict negative returns in >40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows).

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment exceeding 150,000 thousand persons in high-employment expansion indicates labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 150000 fails to yield positive returns in >50% of high-employment expansion instances (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Loose monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) combined with strong industrial output (INDPRO > 100) signals favorable economic conditions, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS<2.5 AND INDPRO>100) yields positive returns in <40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows).
